answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, so a sybil swarm must fund each identity separately. Work history is non-transferable: reputation accrues only to identities that finish verified jobs over time, and a raven-like sentinel service audits random jobs, slashing the stake of any identity caught faking results. One honest agent can wander the network freely, but a tide of fresh sock-puppets faces the same per-identity cost every time, so flooding stops paying.
